observations: Photos show a cooking gas cylinder with a top valve/neck and a curved protective handle/guard.
Photo 0 shows a yellow/tan cylinder body with visible wear/dents and a valve area; a label/sticker is present but not clearly readable.
Photos 1 and 2 show a blue cylinder body with the same style of top valve/neck; the cylinder appears worn with scuffs.
No clear, readable capacity marking (e.g., 12.5kg) is visible in the photos provided.
No clear evidence of a recent pressure test/certification stamp is readable in the photos.

claims.evidence: Capacity marking is not clearly readable in photo 0/1/2.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No readable test/certification stamp or leak-test proof is visible in the photos.
Valve condition is visible but cannot confirm it is 'new' from photos 0/1/2.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (price depends heavily on cylinder size).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (e.g., '12.5kg') and serial/markings on the body/neck.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case match among the comparables (treat as not confirmed 12.5kg).

risks.risk: Leak/test status may be untrue; cylinder could leak or have valve issues.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a proper leak test (soap-bubble check at valve/connection) and/or a recent inspection sticker close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (worst case: assume needs inspection/repair).

risks.risk: Photos show different cylinder colors (yellow vs blue), which may indicate different cylinders or repainting; could be bait-and-switch.
risks.proof: Ask for one continuous video showing the same cylinder from valve top to base, including any markings/serial number, and confirm it matches the listing.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable level until identity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Cylinder condition (dents/rust/impact) may affect safety and re-certification cost.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the base ring, valve guard area, and any dents/rust spots with good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/worn with possible re-certification needs.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the stamped/printed capacity showing '12.5kg' (and any serial/inspection markings).
Close-up photo of the valve and any inspection/test sticker (readable).
Short video leak test: apply soap solution around the valve/neck and show no bubbles.
One continuous video confirming the exact same cylinder (including serial/capacity markings) from top valve to bottom.
response.reason: The photos do not clearly show the cylinder capacity (12.5kg) or any readable certification/leak-test evidence, and the color difference raises identity uncertainty. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct cylinder size and condition.
